leaf_cluster_summaries.summary: US initial jobless claims came in at 206K for the week, slightly below the estimated 210K, indicating a steady labor market.
Micron announces a $10 billion investment over 10 years to build a memory research lab in the United States.

San Francisco Fed President Daly states that rising long-term bond yields are a global issue that blunts policy signals, while defending Fed credibility.
